decision: D-073 (build T-070's design), D-074 (no knee at the extended top is a reported result) and D-075 (P1 keeps one generator process per client; its smoke reads MemAvailable at the heaviest planned run): the user's "Approve both (Recommended)", "Report it (Recommended)" and "Group P4, measure P1 (Recommended)" of 2026-11-07, on tasks/T-070/artifacts/design.md
status: pre-data: written before any P1 ladder or campaign run. For P1 only, it supersedes what `supersedes` names; the earlier records stand otherwise

supersedes.ml/l7v2_prereg.json harm.ladder.levels: ladder.levels below, one list per class
supersedes.ml/p3_prereg.json pool.address_limit: address_limit below, for P1 only; P3 keeps its 300

ladder.order: ascending: a class's ladder stops after the first level that passes in both repeats. The knee is the lowest such level (bench/calibration.knee), so a higher level cannot move it

conditional.C2 16: run only when level 8 ran and did not pass in both repeats
conditional.C3a 6: run only when level 8 is not reachable
conditional.C3b 150: run only when 200 bots are not reachable

seed_map.rule: repeat r of the level at index i of its class's list runs on pilot seed 9001 + ((2 i + r - 1) mod 8); the two repeats of a level never share a seed. The runner refuses a ladder block off the map

statuses.run: the level has attempts; per repeat the last attempt with both runs sound counts (ml/p1_prereg_3.json ladder)
statuses.no_sound_attempt: a repeat with attempts but none sound: counted as no harm by the registered rule, and named
statuses.not_reachable: the plan refused the level on this testbed (the source bounds, the address limit, the memory read); never read as no harm

c3a.index_range: sources 101-320 take an index range of their own after the last family, so that every entity of a lower level keeps its index, sub-seed and address

address_limit.rule: P1's address limit is the largest address count at which the smoke's read passed, at most the ceiling, set by a dated decision in decision_file; until that file exists, the verified 300. A count above 512 would also need the server namespace's neighbour table raised, which this record does not cover

read.run: the heaviest planned run at the count: M_gru_C3b with its daemon when C3b's knee may need the count, else U
read.accept: MemAvailable at or above margin_mb at every sample of the run, no process OOM-killed, every alias added, and the run's view-slip and attack-in-sink checks passed

memory: D-075: P1 keeps one generator process per client; the runner samples MemAvailable every loop into cpu.jsonl, and run.json reports its least value

premise.rule: on the pilot plans at nominal times, a level is 'evades' when the largest per-key (address, UA) window maximum of its primary family's sources stays below the benign per-key quantile on every window, and 'crosses' otherwise, naming the windows. Written by eval/p1_premise.py before any ladder run; a level marked 'crosses' never becomes a knee. Re-read on P3's validation captures, reported, judging nothing

no_knee.result: a class with no level passing in both repeats up to its highest level whose repeats all had a sound attempt (X) is reported as 'no harm reached up to X on this testbed', with every level's status and both repeats' harm. It gets no campaign runs and no verdict
no_knee.campaign: the campaign runs the classes of its live set (or of its cut) that have a knee, C2 alone if it is the only one, and records which; with none, there is no campaign
no_knee.not_reachable: a level not reachable on this testbed is reported as such and never as no harm; if it stops the ladder below the class's registered top, the report says the ladder was cut short
